PER JOINT INVESTMENT FUND MANAGERS, IN THE MUTUAL INVESTMENTS IN TRUST LAW THERE IS NO DEFINITION OF A FUND MANAGER, BUT THERE IS A DEFINITION OF A MANAGEMENT COMPANY AND A PENSION FUND. THE DEFINITIONS REFER TO THE FINANCIAL SERVICES (PENSION FUNDS) SUPERVISION LAW 2005. THEREFORE, A MANAGEMENT COMPANY IS A COMPANY WITH A LICENSE FROM THE CAPITAL MARKET, INSURANCE AND SAVINGS AUTHORITY COMMISSIONER IN ISRAEL. PENSION FUND - RECEIVED APPROVAL UNDER SECTION 13 OF THE LAW FROM THE CAPITAL MARKET, INSURANCE AND SAVINGS AUTHORITY COMMISSIONER IN ISRAEL.
